explanation: Both reports follow the shared listing mode (ListingModeToggle above the gene table and beside the pathway headline). Gene report: in the p < 0.05 listing the table leads with FDR survivors by q then nominal tracks by p; in FDR mode with the FDR survivors by q, as before. Each row carries a data-tier and is labelled under its q (FDR < 0.05 or p < 0.05 only); the q in each cell is a hover-only QTerm and the legend's q is the keyboard-reachable one. Nominal rows show their p beside log2FC, uncoloured. Pathway report: each dataset block leads with its FDR survivors and, in the p < 0.05 listing, its nominal tracks; the DIR column becomes CALL with the shared TierLabel; the FDR header and the legend explain q; block and category open state derive from the mode until the reader toggles them. SigPill, now unused, is removed and FOREST_GRID's last column widens. Significant counts, directions and colours follow the FDR call in both modes; contracts and routes are unchanged.
